payload.note: REVERSE_PHYSICS_NONADDITIVE_CONFORMAL_COUNT closed by REFUTATION (REVERSE_PHYSICS_NO_CONFORMAL_COUNT_ROCQ_V1). The gate asked to construct or refute a non-additive conformally invariant DOF count; the answer is refute. On flat space a dilation pulls the flat metric back to a CONSTANT rescaling, so naturality plus constant Weyl invariance give mu(ball r) = mu(ball 1) for every r - a unit ball and a ball of radius 10^100 tie. ADDITIVITY IS NEVER USED, which is exactly why the non-additive resolution does not escape. All three branches of the Carcassi-Aidala DOF trilemma are now closed under conformal invariance: density by parity, counting measure as uninformative, non-additive here. Reading: in a conformally invariant theory 'how many DOFs are in this region' is not a well-posed question, so their GR conjecture cannot be transported to conformal gravity as written. Geometric inputs are explicit hypotheses, not derived; flat space and constant factors only; extra structure untouched. Gate 16 green 0 red, 84/84 closed, 11 negative controls. New gate: REVERSE_PHYSICS_WHAT_REPLACES_A_COUNT.
